### Are You Ready?
Author: Pastor Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-november-8.html
Passage: Amos 4:12
Points:
- Believers are called to prepare for their final evaluation before God.
- The Judgment Seat of Christ evaluates a believer's service and motives rather than determining salvation.
- Christ took all condemnation upon Himself, meaning sins are fully forgiven for those who trust Him.
- Christians who live for Christ and His kingdom will receive rewards, while selfish living results in loss.
- Believers should examine their current walk and make necessary course corrections today.

### The Limits of God's Patience
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/limits-gods-patience
Passage: Amos 4:1-13
Points:
- God shows great patience and gives repeated warnings so that sinners might repent.
- People walk on thin ice when they presume upon divine kindness, as God's patience will not last indefinitely.
- The Israelites mistakenly assumed their enthusiastic, outward worship excused their exploitation of the poor.
- Multiple disasters were sent as divine wake-up calls, but Israel repeatedly refused to return to God.
- Outward religious observance without a life of repentance remains hollow and displeasing to God.
